drifted.spec_text: All wire messages MUST use a [version][msg_type] header + op_id; unknown message types MUST be logged and ignored; servers MUST echo op_id.
drifted.actual: Framing and op_id echo are correct and unknown/malformed frames are ignored, but neither the WireMessage::Unknown arm nor the malformed-decode (Err) arm emits a log line, so the 'logged' half of the requirement is unmet.

drifted.spec_text: batch_lookup signature MUST be fn(&self, &[(CacheKey, IpcHandle)]) -> Vec<Result<(), RemoteLookupError>>.
drifted.actual: Superseded by 002: signature is &[(CacheKey, u32 /*size*/)]; IpcHandle dropped because remote-lookup is CPU/DRAM-only. Intentional, non-actionable.

drifted.spec_text: Each entry MUST produce a log message (placeholder behavior).
drifted.actual: Superseded by 002: real KEY_QUERY->RDMA protocol, no per-entry placeholder log. Non-actionable.

drifted.spec_text: The placeholder MUST return Err(NotFound) for each entry (no network I/O).
drifted.actual: Superseded by 002: performs real zyre + one-sided RDMA I/O; Ok(()) when resident. Non-actionable.

drifted.spec_text: The component MUST expose functionality only through IRemoteLookup - no public functions outside the interface.
drifted.actual: Superseded by 002 FR-029: peers_seen/signal_shutdown/shutdown are intentional out-of-interface teardown/test hooks. Non-actionable.

drifted.spec_text: The interface compiles with the same (CacheKey, IpcHandle) parameter types as IDispatcher::batch_lookup.
drifted.actual: Superseded by 002: compiles with (CacheKey, u32). Non-actionable.

unspecced.suggested_spec: Note the hardcoded ack-handshake bound in FR-014/FR-031, distinct from the configurable connection_teardown_timeout orphan grace.
Extend FR-018 to require logging of malformed (WireError) frames, not only unknown message types; fold into the FR-018 logging ALIGN task.
Document in FR-006 that a racing AlreadyExists counts as success only at matching size; a differing size is reclaimed (never evicted). Already in knowledge/size-mismatch-handling.md.
